item.title: Bruins Get A Quick Chance To Answer After Frustrating Thanksgiving Eve Loss
item.description: Bruins Get A Quick Chance To Answer After Frustrating Thanksgiving Eve Loss originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Boston Bruins don’t have to wait long to find out whether Wednesday’s loss was a bump in the road or a sign of something that needs attention. Boston fell 4-2 to Winnipeg at TD Garden on Thanksgiving Eve, twice drawing even before the Jets pulled ahead for good. The Bruins’ next game comes Friday afternoon against Toronto, giving them little time to dwell on a frustrating night. The Bruins found an early response after Winnipeg scored just over a minute into the game. Morgan Geekie tied it on the power play, finishing a cross-ice feed from David Pastrnak. Boston later pulled even again when Fraser Minten scored his ninth goal of the season. Better Starts Could Keep Boston Out Of Trouble The Bruins spent much of Wednesday chasing the game. Goaltender Jeremy Swayman said afterward that Boston needed to be ready from the opening puck drop, an issue that could be costly against any opponent. Wishing everyone a wonderful Thanksgiving! 🦃 https://t.co/haXXoaSy04 — Boston Bruins (@NHLBruins) November 26, 2026 The power play did provide a bright spot. Geekie’s goal was his fourth with the man advantage, giving him the team lead in power-play goals. But Boston could not turn that early spark into sustained control, and Winnipeg found the deciding goal in the second period. MORE : Bruins' 22-Year-Old Forward Continues To Provide Optimism Despite Latest Loss Toronto Provides A Timely Division Test Friday’s game is the first meeting of the season between the Bruins and Maple Leafs. It also arrives at a useful time: Boston can respond quickly in front of its home crowd instead of carrying the disappointment through several days off. The 1 p.m. ET start at TD Garden gives the afternoon a holiday-week feel, but the points count the same. Boston’s focus is straightforward: start with more urgency, build on the power-play production and avoid giving Toronto an early lead to chase. item.title: Players Era Tournament: Tennessee handles Iowa State, advances to bracket final
item.description: LAS VEGAS, NEVADA - NOVEMBER 26: Tyler Lundblade #7 and Dai Dai Ames #4 of the Tennessee Volunteers react together against the Iowa State Cyclones during the second half during a Semifinal in the Players Era 16 bracket of The 2026 Players Era Men's Championship at Michelob ULTRA Arena on November 26, 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada. (Photo by Zach Del Bello/Players Era/Getty Images) | Getty Images No. 9 Tennessee never trailed on Thanksgiving in Las Vegas, downing Iowa State, 75-64. The Volunteers came away with their second straight big win of the week, advancing to the Michelob Ultra Arena bracket final on Friday. Tennessee will face the winner of Louisville and St. Johns. Once again for the Vols, it was Dai Dai Ames coming off the bench to lead the scoring for Tennessee. It was Ames assisting Terrence Hill Jr. for the first three of the game, then Ames connecting on one of his own. Tennessee’s quick start saw their lead swell to 14 points before the halftime break. Tennessee would control things for much of the second half, but a late push from Iowa State brought the Cyclones back to within five points. Jamarion Batemon hit a couple of three-pointers as the Cyclones continued to hang around. However, it was Terrence Hill Jr. breaking a full court press, streaking to the basket to extend Tennessee’s lead back out to seven with just two minutes left to play. Dai Dai Ames then drilled a step-back three just seconds later for the final dagger. dagger. Dai Dai. 📺 ESPN 📲 https://t.co/6AYvbSrt9f pic.twitter.com/bvv9MLhSyz — Tennessee Basketball (@Vol_Hoops) November 26, 2026 Tennessee, as you would expect playing Iowa State struggled with turnovers (16), but made up for it on the boards. The Volunteers won the rebounding battle 46-38, and finished up 15-17 from the free throw stripe. Iowa State was just 10-18. Ames finished with a team-high 19 points on 8-14 shooting. Hill added 17 points and four assists. DeWayne Brown added 13 rebounds. Braeden Lue grabbed eight rebounds and added three blocks, playing some really key minutes down the stretch. Jalen Haralson returned to action, handling 18 minutes of play. The Notre Dame transfer scored six points and added five boards. Tennessee now moves to the bracket final, which is set for 9 p.m. ET on Friday night. The tournament final is set for Saturday.

item.title: Boston College Has A New Reason To Believe In Its 2027 Offense
item.description: Boston College Has A New Reason To Believe In Its 2027 Offense originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Boston College still has one game left this season, but the Eagles already have a meaningful piece of next year’s offense in place. Quarterback Mason McKenzie said he plans to return to Chestnut Hill in 2027. The redshirt junior transferred from Division II Saginaw Valley State before this season, so another year in Bill O’Brien’s offense could bring a smoother transition and more room to grow. McKenzie has totaled 2,516 all-purpose yards this season, including 1,798 passing yards and 718 on the ground. He has accounted for 17 touchdowns, with 12 passing scores and five rushing touchdowns. The Eagles have also had to navigate a challenging season, making the quarterback’s commitment a welcome sign of stability. McKenzie’s Mobility Gives BC A Foundation McKenzie ranks among the ACC’s top quarterbacks in rushing production. His 718 yards on the ground lead conference quarterbacks, and that ability gives Boston College another way to move the ball when passing lanes close. QB Mason McKenzie will return next year to Boston College, he announced during his press conference Tuesday morning. — Graham Dietz (@graham_dietz) November 24, 2026 The Eagles have also found a productive running back in Bo MacCormack, who rushed for a career-high 236 yards against Syracuse. The combination gives BC a starting point for building an offense that can pressure defenses in more than one way. Miami Offers A Final Measure Of Progress The Eagles close the season Saturday at No. 4 Miami, a 10-1 team that has gone unbeaten in ACC play. Boston College enters at 5-6, so it will need its best performance of the year to finish with a win against one of the country’s top teams. The defense could help keep the game within reach. BC has 17 takeaways, including 13 interceptions, tied for the most in the ACC. The Eagles’ challenge is to turn those opportunities into points while making the most of McKenzie’s mobility and MacCormack’s running. Saturday’s result will shape how the season is remembered. McKenzie’s decision gives the program a reason to look beyond it. item.title: Boston College Stays Unbeaten After Money Williams’ Wild Finish Against UCF
item.description: Boston College Stays Unbeaten After Money Williams’ Wild Finish Against UCF originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Boston College’s perfect start nearly ended in Florida. Instead, Money Williams made his return count in the most dramatic way possible. Williams scored 27 points, and the Eagles edged UCF 75-73 Thursday at the ESPN Events Invitational. With the game tied in the closing seconds, Williams drove toward the basket and his layup attempt was ruled a goaltend. The call put Boston College ahead with two seconds left, and UCF had no answer before the buzzer. The finish rescued a game in which the Eagles had to find other ways to win. Boston College shot 37% from the field and made only five of its 16 three-point attempts. But the Eagles controlled the glass, outrebounding UCF 47-28, and made 30 of 35 free throws. Williams Gives The Eagles A Timely Lift Williams had been sidelined for Boston College’s previous three games with a foot injury. His return gave the Eagles a scorer they sorely needed in a tight game, and he went 10-for-10 at the line. 7-0‼️ https://t.co/fw5eiB0UYs — BC Men's Basketball (@BCMBB) November 26, 2026 UCF made the Eagles work for every inch. The Knights shot 39% from the field and turned the ball over just six times, compared with 13 for Boston College. Dior Johnson led UCF with 23 points, keeping the pressure on until the final possession. MORE : How to Watch UConn vs. Duke Tonight: Channel, Live Stream & Start Time for College Basketball Game A Perfect Record, With A Tough Test Ahead The win moved Boston College to 7-0, its best start in years. The Eagles will have to regroup quickly, with another ESPN Events Invitational game on Friday. The UCF result offered a useful early-season lesson: Boston College can win even when its outside shots are not falling. The rebounding and free-throw work made the difference this time. Staying unbeaten will require the Eagles to bring that same toughness into the next game. item.description: Happy Thanksgiving, Philadelphia Eagles fans. Let’s see if the Birds can score an upset win against the Dallas Cowboys at AT&T Stadium in Week 12 NFL action. The Eagles (3-7) are coming off their first win in two months, beating the Pittsburgh Steelers last Sunday — a victory that played a factor in the Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy drama that has since unfolded. More importantly for the Eagles, their 19-16 victory over the Steelers ended a brutal seven-game losing streak. But now, the Cowboys (5-6) and their high-powered offense awaits Nick Sirianni’s team on Turkey Day. The Cowboys are in the hunt for first place in the NFC East, trailing the division-leading New York Giants (6-3-1). Understandably, Dallas is a heavy 8.5-point favorite vs. Joe Milton and the Eagles, per FanDuel Sportsbook . But can the former Cowboys QB spring an upset against his old team? Milton will need plenty of help from Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith and Philly’s defense — which will have its hands full with Ceedee Lamb, George Pickens and Co. The last time these two teams met was in Week 7, when Lamb had two touchdowns, Pickens scored, and the Cowboys won going away, 38-21, at Lincoln Financial Field. We’ll see if the Eagles can keep this one closer — or if it’s more of the same on Thanksgiving in Texas. Stay tuned for updates here throughout the game. item.title: Bears incredible Thanksgiving win comes with Caleb Williams injury scare
item.description: Mandatory Credit: David Reginek-Imagn Images Bears incredible Thanksgiving win comes with Caleb Williams injury scare appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Chicago Bears were trailing against the Detroit Lions throughout the entire game. However, quarterback Caleb Williams was not about to simply accept a close but hard-fought defeat on Thanksgiving Day. Instead, he executed two dramatic TD drives late in the fourth quarter, and the last one resulted in a game-winning 6-yard TD pass to wide receiver Rome Odunze with 3 seconds remaining. That play gave the Bears a 39-35 triumph over their NFC North rivals and allowed Chicago to gain a one-game lead over the Lions in the division race. The touchdown culminated a 13-play, 68-yard TD drive and set off a celebration on the Bears sidelines. Prior to the game-winning drive, the Bears had cut an 11-point Detroit lead to three points when Williams and Odunze connected on a 41-yard TD pass with 7:30 remaining. Williams followed with a 2-point conversion run, and that cut the deficit to three points. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Williams had a huge game for the Bears, as he completed 30 of 44 passes for 345 yards with 2 TD passes. After the game, Williams was seen going in for an X-ray . It may have been a precautionary move because he did celebrate with his teammates on the field, shake hands with the Lions and then do an interview with CBS after the game. The quarterback said the X-ray was on his midsection . Running back D’Andre Swift caught 7 passes from Williams for a team-leading 97 yards. He also ran for 65 yards and a touchdown. The Lions received a sensational effort from running back Jahmyr Gibbs. He carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards with 3 TDs, including a 70-yard run for a score in the fourth quarter. item.title: LeBron James Praises Spoelstra, Sparks Fan Fury Over Miami Move
item.description: Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images LeBron James just dropped a truth bomb that has the NBA talking. After the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 on Wednesday night, James did not hold back his respect for his former boss. According to reporters, Erik Spoelstra is the finest coach he has ever played under. James posted a triple-double featuring 25 points, 12 assists, and 10 rebounds when that remark was made. The win snapped Miami’s seven-game winning streak and moved the 76ers to a 15-4 record. But the real story is how fans are reacting to James putting his old coach on a pedestal. The High Praise Comes With a Price James made his feelings clear during his postgame interview. He called Spoelstra a first-ballot Hall of Famer and one of the best coaches in the league. “Spo is a first-ballot Hall of Famer. He’s one of the best coaches in our league. Obviously, the best coach I’ve had,” James said, according to Pro Football Network . This is a huge compliment coming from a player with 24 years of experience who has worked with 11 different coaches. He led the Heat to four straight appearances when James was there from 2010 to 2014. Yet, some fans think this praise hurts James’s current team. One fan on social media called the comment disrespectful to Nick Nurse, the 76ers’ current coach. The fan wrote, “True statement but disrespectful as [expletive] to his current coach saying his old coach was the best coach he ever had.” It is a tough spot for James to be in. He wants to honor the man who helped him win two championships while trying to win with a new group. Spoelstra noticed this balance too. He told reporters that James is letting his new teammates feel comfortable and be who they have been. “I think what he’s doing that’s brilliant, for that group is he’s allowing other guys to feel comfortable and, and be who they’ve been, previously,” Spoelstra explained. But that does not stop the criticism from the fans who remember the past. History Boils the Pot for Fans The backlash gets hotter when people remember what happened in 2010. Early in that season, the Heat started 9-8 and the team chemistry was messy. Following a defeat, conflict escalated to the point where James allegedly collided with Spoelstra on the sideline. The players even held a meeting without the coach. Certain reports claim James inquired with team president Pat Riley about whether he would ever get “the itch” to coach again. Fans see this as a time when James wanted Spoelstra fired. One user pointed this out directly. “Leaving out the part where he tried to get Spo fired 10 games into their first year together,” one user said. Another fan wrote, “Says the guy who tried to get him fired.” This history makes the current praise feel strange to some observers. Many fans wish James had gone back to Miami instead of signing with Philadelphia. item.title: QB Brock Purdy doesn't practice again for 49ers, second straight since Sunday win in Mexico
item.description: San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy throws a pass during their game against the Minnesota Vikings in Mexico City, Sunday, Nov. 22, 2026. (Fernando Llano/Associated Press) Quarterback Brock Purdy has been unable to participate in the San Francisco 49ers ' first two practices of the week after playing on a sprained left ankle for the final two quarters of 35-10 win against the Vikings last Sunday. Purdy's absence during the Thanksgiving Day practice came a day after head coach Kyle Shanahan indicated Purdy wasn't dealing with a long-term injury, noting he didn't suffer a high-ankle sprain. Shanahan was asked if there was "concern" Purdy would be unavailable when the 49ers host the Seahawks on Sunday. "He can't (practice) today," Shanahan said. "So it's always a possibility." Purdy was hurt on the 49ers' penultimate offensive snap of the first half when he flung the ball with his left hand and was called for intentional grounding after defensive tackle Jalen Redmond rolled up on his ankle while applying pressure. Purdy showed no visible signs of being injured in the final two quarters. With the 49ers leading 28-10 at halftime, he completed 9 of 11 passes for 79 yards in the second half. At one point, he rolled right under pressure, ducked under linebacker Kyle Van Noy and flipped a 7-yard completion to tight end Luke Farrell. The 49ers fielded calls about backup QB Mac Jones before the trade deadline earlier this month. But they held onto the 2021 first-round pick who ranked second in the NFL in completion percentage last year while making eight starts when Purdy was sidelined with turf toe. General manager John Lynch made it clear the 49ers' asking price for Jones wasn't modest. "We'd have to be really motivated to move Mac," Lynch said. "Kind of a situation where it makes too much sense in terms of … what we were able to receive." Subscribe There’s more to San Francisco with the Chronicle. Subscribe today for just 25¢. item.title: Ford unveils GT41 Hypercar at Ford Field, hoping for first overall Le Mans win since 1969
item.description: LANSING, Mich. (WLNS) — Ford Racing unveiled its new race car, the Ford GT41, on Thursday at Ford Field during the Detroit Lions’ Thanksgiving Day game against the Chicago Bears. The car will carry the Dearborn-based automaker back to the top class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans next year. It’s Ford’s first attempt at an overall Le Mans win since 1969. Ford won the race four years in a row, from 1966 to 1969, with the GT40. That run included a 1-2-3 finish in 1966, as highlighted in the 2019 film Ford v. Ferrari starring Matt Damon and Christian Bale. How long do Thanksgiving leftovers last? Here’s what the USDA says The GT41 will race in the Hypercar class of the FIA World Endurance Championship. The 2027 season opens in March in Qatar. Le Mans follows in June and the Lone Star Le Mans in Austin, Texas, follows in September. “The Ford GT41 is exactly the kind of audacious, go-like-hell project that gets our blood pumping,” said Bill Ford, executive chair of Ford Motor Co. Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) Fprd's GT41 Hypercar (Ford Racing) The car runs on a naturally aspirated 5.4-liter V8 based on Ford’s Coyote engine, the same engine family used in the Mustang. Ford Racing designed and built the engine in-house. The V8 works with a hybrid system. The GT41 is built under LMDh rules. Automakers use a chassis from an approved supplier and a standard hybrid system. Then they design their own engine and bodywork. Ford’s chassis comes from the French company ORECA. Ford is running the team itself instead of hiring an outside racing operation. “There are no shortcuts to success,” program manager Dan Sayers said. Ford has named six drivers: Logan Sargeant, Tom Blomqvist, Matt Campbell, Sebastian Priaulx, Mike Rockenfeller and Nick Yellowly. Tom Dillmann is the reserve driver. Sargeant is the most recent American to drive in Formula 1, the single-seater racing series. He spent two years in the sport at Williams Racing, and the team didn’t renew his contract amid poor performances. The car tested in Europe this year, including a 30-hour endurance run in Spain. More testing is planned in the United States in December and January. The blue-on-blue design shown Thursday includes hidden images. Among them are an American flag, a bald eagle and the Spirit of Detroit statue. Ford said the final race design will be revealed before the season opener. McLaren Racing, another former Le Mans champion, will also return to the top endurance class next season. Ford's other rivals are Ferrari, Toyota, Aston Martin, BMW, Cadillac and Genesis. Alpine and Peugeot are not racing in the Hypercar class in 2027, with both manufacturers leaving. Ford has not announced a street-legal version of the GT41.

item.title: Saquon Barkley hits back at Nick Sirianni after sideline bust-up with Eagles player
item.description: Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images Philadelphia Eagles fans are just waiting for their season to be over, and it seems as if some of their players and coaches may feel the same way, The Eagles made the trip to face the Dallas Cowboys on Thanksgiving, with the early play at AT&T Stadium leaving plenty of frustrated figures on the Eagles’ sideline. Head coach Nick Sirianni found himself exchanging words with one of his players. The heated exchange between Sirianni and running back Will Shipley even saw the veteran Saquon Barkley get involved to seemingly stick up for his teammate as the Eagles trailed the Cowboys inside the opening half. Nick Sirianni goes off on Philadelphia Eagles player Will Shipley on Thanksgiving The Eagles roster has been absolutely decimated by injuries, with Philadelphia heading into the game against Dallas at the bottom of the division, and with a dismal 3-7 record. Tempers flared inside the opening minutes of the game after the Eagles failed to convert a fourth-down play. A fourth-and-one play inside the first quarter saw Barkley attempt to run it straight up the middle. The failed play call clearly left Shipley far from impressed, with the backup running back getting into it with his head coach. With neither Shipley nor Sirianni backing down, Barkley attempted to calm the situation down. What was exactly said is unknown, but the Eagles were clearly failing to control their emotions as the Cowboys had their way with them from the very start of the game. The Cowboys extended a massive lead heading into the break. For the Eagles, it is now just a case of seeing the season out, with their hopes of making the postseason long gone after suffering numerous injuries earlier in the year. item.title: Oliver Bearman Haas Contract: Why Money Delayed His Renewal
item.description: Oliver Bearman has become, almost without wanting to, the last driver on the grid without a contract for 2027, a situation unthinkable a few months ago when his continuity at Haas seemed a done deal and the announcement of his renewal was taken for imminent. However Rafael Câmara's signing by the American team was made official and since then the silence about Bearman has been prolonged until becoming one of the soap operas of the driver market, the paradox is evident: the driver needs Haas and Haas needs the driver but neither of the two finishes taking the definitive step. As has been learned, the origin of the stagnation is none other than the economic negotiation, the Haas team has presented a salary offer that the British driver and his environment consider insufficient, taking into account his performance and his progression in the two seasons he has been in Formula 1. Ferrari owner of his sporting rights has already exercised the option that allows it to keep him within its young driver program, so there are no obstacles on that side, the question is reduced to a tug of war between the economic parties that has been hardening with the passage of the weeks. F1 Daily: Herta Leaves F2, FIA's Full-Time Stewards in 2027, and a Potential Engine Supplier Bid in 2030 The FIA is finally leaning towards hiring full-time stewards next year. Bearman's frustration is evident, in the preview of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, the Briton did not hide his disappointment: "There is nothing new to say, to be honest I am quite disappointed to find myself here, in the twentieth event of the season without a signed contract for next year. It is a strange situation but we are resolving it" he declared. The 21-year-old driver has admitted that the uncertainty is affecting his confidence, despite considering that he has done enough merits to renew: "I can only say that it is a bit disappointing and obviously, it is not ideal for a driver's confidence. I know I have done a good job this year but not knowing what I will do next season is not exactly ideal, of that there is no doubt" he added. Bearman categorically ruled out the possibility of signing for another team: "No, zero possibilities" he sentenced when asked if there was any alternative to Haas, a response that confirms the driver's scarce margin for maneuver, taking into account that all the available seats for 2027 have already been assigned. His immediate objective is to continue at Haas where he feels he has pending work while keeping his sights set on his great dream: to one day reach Ferrari: "I have a contract with Ferrari that has given me this incredible opportunity to reach Formula 1, I am still a driver of the young talent program and my greatest dream is to race for Ferrari, it is the most emblematic team and it was the first to believe in me when I was a child, it is still my greatest dream but it is evident that looking to the future, some difficulties could arise" he explained. item.title: Miami’s Top Prospect Malachi Toney Faces Uncertain Return
item.description: Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images Darian Mensah holds the number one quarterback rating in the entire country at 86.3, per reports. This junior signal caller from San Luis Obispo, Calif.this season, the quarterback has accumulated 3,317 yards and 29 touchdowns while throwing only four interceptions. Boston College travels to Coral Gables, Fla., on Saturday at noon to face the top-ranked offense in the ACC. The Hurricanes enter the game with a 10-1 record and look to sweep their conference slate for the first time. Boston College coach Bill O’Brien knows the challenge ahead is massive despite his team’s recent win over Syracuse. The Eagles are 5-6 and need a win to guarantee bowl eligibility, according to the National Football Post . O’Brien added, “We got one more game. And we’ll show up in Miami. We’ll get on the plane, we’ll go down there, and we’ll make sure we’re there, to play Miami. And then we’ll see what happens.” The Missing Star and the Backup Plan Superstar wide receiver Malachi Toney remains questionable for Saturday due to a high ankle sprain. Although he has missed the past three games, Miami head coach Mario Cristobal provided a positive update on his recovery. “He’s looking great,” Cristobal commented on Toney, who possesses 1,027 yards from 73 catches and continues to top the ACC in touchdown catches with 13. “I mean, you saw him run, you know, and with all the cutting and running routes. So I mean he’s doing really, really well. We’ll see.” If Toney cannot play, the Hurricanes have other weapons ready to go. Cooper Barkate, a former Duke teammate, has logged 653 yards and six touchdowns via 52 catches this season. Tight end Elija Lofton is expected to return after leaving the Virginia Tech game in the first half. The running back duo consists of senior Mark Fletcher Jr and freshman Javian Mallory. their combined efforts total 1,224 yards and 22 scores across 225 rushing attempts. Defensive Concerns for the Eagles Boston College linebacker Anthony Palano admits stopping the Miami offense will be extremely difficult even without Toney. “I mean, there’s really no slowing it down,” Anthony Palano, the Eagles’ leading tackler and a BC linebacker, remarked on Toney. “You got to try and limit it. That guy, he’s explosive, definitely. Just watching him and some of the tape that he’s got, [we’re] just trying to limit what he can do, which is going to be tough.” The stats show Miami is a juggernaut on both sides of the ball. Per reports, the Hurricanes rank 5th overall and 1st in offense, while the Eagles sit at 102nd in FBS. Miami converts 54 percent of third downs, which ranks 2nd in the nation. Boston College converts only 35 percent of the time on third down, good for 96th. The Eagles also struggle on fourth down, converting just 27 percent of the time. Boston College won the last time these teams met in Miami back in 2011. The Hurricanes lead the all-time series 25-6.

item.title: Ilzer and Prass hail Hoffenheim's strong second-half showing against Sturm Graz
item.description: Ilzer and Prass hail Hoffenheim's strong second-half showing against Sturm Graz Christian Ilzer expressed his delight at TSG Hoffenheim's come from behind win over Sturm Graz in the Europa League this evening . “It was a very complicated game for us. Sturm Graz deservedly took the lead in the first half," Ilzer said in his post match press conference. "They were more alert than us. If we don't perform at our best in the basics, then it starts to become difficult for us. "We had two excellent chances that we didn't convert. Sturm played very well, but we weren't at all satisfied with the first half. "However, we also knew that we could improve. The reaction we showed deserves credit to my team. In the end, we deserved to win. “This victory is really good for us. We're now in a good position to get through the league phase. That's our main goal,” he added. Speaking after his coach, Alexander Prass gave a similar insight into the game as he took on the club he represented from 2021 to 2024. “In the first half, we allowed exactly what we didn't want: Sturm to play long balls. We weren't aggressive enough. "In the second half, we showed a completely different side of ourselves. Because it was also a matter of energy. "We said we had to push harder. Then we stepped it up a notch or two, and our performance was simply better. “And we're a great team that can bring top players off the bench. It was nice for me to see many familiar faces from Graz again,” he said. The Sinsheim club will hope to rest and regain energy quickly as attention turns to Sunday afternoon's clash at home to FC Augsburg.

item.title: Geyse named best footballer at the 2026 Prêmio Brasil Olímpico
item.description: Geyse named best footballer at the 2026 Prêmio Brasil Olímpico Geyse, a forward for América (MEX), was the Mexican League’s top scorer in 2026 Credits: Luciana Vermell/CBF Forward Geyse has won the Brazilian Olympic Committee’s (COB) “Best in Sport – Football” award. The winners across all 53 Olympic sports have already been announced, but the 2026 Brazil Olympic Awards ceremony will take place on December 2 at 5:30 p.m. at Cidade das Artes in Rio de Janeiro. In addition to recognizing one athlete or team per sport for their performance throughout the year, the COB will also announce awards linked to the 2026 competitions at the ceremony, including Breakthrough Athlete, Team of the Year, Best Coaches, and Outstanding Olympic Club, among others. Geyse is with the Brazilian Women’s National Team in Hiroshima, Japan, where they will play the first of two friendlies against Japan on December 29. As the second match takes place on December 5 in Okayama, she will not attend the awards ceremony in Rio de Janeiro. A memorable year In January 2026, the forward was announced as a new signing for Mexico’s Club América, where she has made her mark. This season, she scored 21 goals to finish as the Mexican League’s top scorer, while also leading the league in assists. “This has been a challenging year with many achievements, one in which I was able to rediscover my love of football at América,” Geyse said in celebration. Called up by Arthur Elias in February for friendlies against Costa Rica, Venezuela, and Mexico, she returned to the national team after two years away. Since then, she has taken part in a training camp in Itu in June and friendlies against Argentina in October. She is now part of the squad for the year’s final FIFA international window in Japan. item.title: What Bryson DeChambeau did in 2021 that really impressed Rory McIlroy, ‘it’s amazing to watch’
item.description: Photo by Keyur Khamar/PGA TOUR via Getty Images Bryson DeChambeau and Rory McIlroy may be unlikely to spend Thanksgiving together any time soon, but back in 2021, the Northern Irishman was full of praise for the two-time US Open champion after he competed in the World Long Drive Championship. DeChambeau is unquestionably one of the most influential golfers of this era. It did not take long for the American to become one of the most recognisable figures in the game when he burst onto the scene, with his unique attire and set of one-length irons. He also changed the game from late 2019, with DeChambeau undergoing a significant body transformation as he looked to add considerable speed. It undoubtedly helped him become a major champion as he won the US Open at Winged Foot. But it also allowed DeChambeau to enter into the world of Long Drive. In fact, DeChambeau reached the final in 2021, which took place just days after he helped Team USA to a record victory at the Ryder Cup at Whistling Straits. What Rory McIlroy said about Bryson DeChambeau competing in Long Drive in 2021 DeChambeau’s longest drive of 391 yards was not enough to take him past the top-eight stage. Nevertheless, he definitely brought plenty of attention to the event. And one of those who was won over was none other than Rory McIlroy , as he told the No Laying Up Podcast later that year as he discussed how to get more people involved with the game. “I had to commend Bryson in the Bahamas a couple of weeks ago. I said I have never tuned in to watch a long drive competition before, and I was on YouTube and I was like, ‘this is unbelievable’,” he said. “Even stuff like that is cool. It’s different, and I commended him for at least being comfortable being different. This is something that’s a big passion for him and he went at it. It’s amazing to watch him hit the golf ball at the minute. All that different stuff, I think there’s a place for all of it in the game.” Rory McIlroy opened up on the decision to try and copy Bryson DeChambeau’s approach It is well known that McIlroy tried to go down a similar path to DeChambeau following his US Open win in 2020. DeChambeau won by six shots and was the only player to finish under par for the tournament. Unfortunately, it did not reap similar rewards for McIlroy. The six-time major champion went around 18 months without a PGA Tour win between 2019 and 2021. He also only had one top-five in a major across 2020 and 2021. item.title: ‘An Absolute Superstar’ – NBA Insider Hypes ‘Underrated’ Western Conference Forward After 33-Point Explosion vs. Victor Wembanyama, Spurs
item.description: NBA insider Kevin O'Connor puts Deni Avdija in superstar company after his 33-point night against the Spurs. Deni Avdija scored 33 points Wednesday night as the Portland Trail Blazers held off Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs 116-111 in NBA Cup group play. The following day, NBA insider Kevin O’Connor made an emphatic case for the Blazers forward on his podcast, “The Kevin O’Connor Show.” What Kevin O’Connor Sees in Deni Avdija’s Growth This Season “He’s just better this year than he was last year,” O’Connor said of Avdija, a point he pressed more than once. O’Connor paired that comparison with a verdict on Avdija’s reputation and a rundown of his game: “I think Deni Avdija is still underrated. … He brought back all of the things he did last year, the downhill attacking, the playmaking within the flow of the offense, the rebounding within the wing spot, all of that stuff, and a better 3-point shot at over 40% this year. This guy looks like an absolute superstar for the Blazers.” That 3-point shot was on display against the Spurs, as Avdija made 5 of his 8 attempts from deep. The rest of his list showed up too. Avdija repeatedly got downhill, scoring several times at the rim. He grabbed 12 rebounds, 10 of them on the defensive glass. He also handed out 7 assists, matching Damian Lillard and Jrue Holiday for the team lead, and two of them set up alley-oop dunks by Robert Williams III. O’Connor also wrote: “Deni Avdija looks like a superstar. Not just an All-Star. A superstar. He’s even better than last year’s breakout. Way better.” The lead changed hands 25 times. Wembanyama led all scorers with 44 points on 17-for-30 shooting, and added 16 rebounds and 2 blocks. The Spurs, who fell to 15-4, carried an 87-84 lead into the fourth quarter. Avdija scored 9 of Portland’s 32 points in a fourth quarter the Blazers won by 8. After Wembanyama’s alley-oop dunk tied the game at 109 with two minutes left, Avdija scored 6 of the Blazers’ final 7 points. His two free throws put Portland back in front, and with 38.6 seconds remaining he took a pass from Lillard and banked in a 26-foot 3-pointer for a 114-109 lead. He also grabbed 2 defensive rebounds in the final minute, and his free throw with 2.7 seconds left set the 116-111 final. READ MORE: ‘We’re Either Going To Be Contenders or a Fake Team’ — JJ Redick Braces Lakers for Media ‘Overreactions’ Ahead of Blockbuster Spurs Showdown Avdija finished with 33 points on 11-for-21 shooting, went 6 of 8 at the line and had 2 steals in 36 minutes. The win improved Portland to 12-6, and the Blazers sit sixth in the Western Conference. The result also left the Blazers 2-1 in NBA Cup group play with a plus-12 point differential, and they remain in the running for a knockout-round wild card. San Antonio leads the group at plus-48. Portland closes group play Friday at home against the Golden State Warriors, with a knockout-round berth still to be decided. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Juventus 4 – Omonia Nicosia 1: Initial reaction and random observations
item.description: TURIN, ITALY - NOVEMBER 26: Jeff Ekhator of Juventus celebrates his goal during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD5 match between Juventus and Omonia FC at Juventus Stadium on November 26, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Image Photo Agency/Getty Images) | Getty Images With a starting lineup that was heavily rotated and full of backups, Luciano Spalletti clearly signaled that his mind was already on what’s to come this weekend by Lake Como. All of those changes, however, made for some very interesting play — and not in a good way — for much of the first half of Thursday night’s Europa League tie against Omonia Nicosia. As it turned out, Juventus just needed to spot ‘em one for them to actually start playing some ball. After gifting Omonia Nicosia the first goal of the game, Juventus went on to score four unanswered — including two goals in the final eight minutes of the first half from Andrea Cambiaso and Jeff Ekhator to flip the score in their favor heading into the half. They added two more goals through Francisco Conceição — who assisted on both of the first-half strikes — and Jérémie Boga to pull away and not risk dropping three more points in the Europa League to claim a 4-1 win that lited them up to second in the league phase table with three matchdays to go. Now that they sit on 13 points, Juventus are even closer to clinching a spot in the top eight — which will be a big development for this squad considering how thin they’ve been depth-wise and don’t need an extra two games added to the schedule come the new year. So while it didn’t start out all that great — and that’s certainly an understatement considering the first half largely resembled the opening 45 minutes from over the weekend against Venezia from a technical level — the final score was what a whole host of us hoped to see. But once they got going and actually looked functional again, it was a lot like what happened over the weekend, too. The Cambiaso goal — one of the best strikes we’ve seen from a Juventus player this season — was a moment of individual brilliance to hit the ball to pull the score even. Then Ekhator’s first Juve goal was a nice little combination of a number of players both winning the ball back and then setting a quick counter going the other way. The assist from Conceição to Ekhator was nice. The run, the turn and then the finish from the young Italian was nice, too. The lead, just like that, was Juventus’ to have and ultimately keep. The way they went about it for much of the first half, though, wasn’t great. That was the worrying sign no matter how much rotating of the starting lineup was done. The errors being made were all too familiar — which pretty resulted in Juve doing absolutely nothing in the attack third against an opponent who has been really struggling over the past five or six games. item.title: Bam Adebayo’s Heat Promise To LeBron Backfires In 76ers Loss
item.description: Credit: Rhona Wise-Imagn Images Bam Adebayo promised to crush LeBron James after the superstar chose Philadelphia over Miami. That promise hit a wall on Thanksgiving Eve. The Miami Heat lost 111-104 to the short-handed 76ers. With 25 points, 12 assists, and 10 rebounds, LeBron achieved a triple-double. Adebayo managed 17 points and 11 rebounds but struggled on offense. He shot just 6-for-16 from the field. The Heat had won seven straight games before this loss. That streak ended in a humbling defeat against a team missing Joel Embiid. The Promise and the Reality When LeBron announced he was signing with the 76ers, Adebayo spoke to reporters. He said he felt no disappointment for his friend. He told LeBron he would “bust his a” the next time they met. That message sounded confident. It set the stage for a showdown. The game happened on Wednesday night. The result was a disaster for Miami. LeBron controlled the pace while Adebayo faded. The Heat shot only 25.8 percent from three-point range. Philadelphia connected on 40 percent of their deep shots. The gap in shooting killed Miami’s chances. Giannis Antetokounmpo tried to carry the load. He scored 32 points and grabbed 14 rebounds. But his teammate Adebayo did not match that energy. Adebayo scored 10 of his 17 points in the fourth quarter. He was quiet for most of the game. Per HITC , Adebayo was thoroughly outclassed by James. The stats show the difference clearly. LeBron had 9-of-15 shooting while Adebayo had 6-of-16. The Heat could not keep up with the 76ers’ offense. Shaq’s Blunt Criticism Former NBA legend Shaquille O’Neal saw a clear problem in Adebayo’s play. He spoke on Inside the NBA after the game. “When I watch the Heat play, and, you know, Giannis is gonna do his thing, but Bam, he waits for his opportunity,” Shaq said. He argued that Adebayo was too passive. He waited for the ball instead of creating his own shots. Kenny Smith pushed back at first. He pointed to the Heat’s recent winning streak. “He wasn’t waiting in those seven games. That was the difference,” Smith said. Shaq clarified that his comments were about this specific game against Philadelphia. Smith agreed with the assessment. “Yeah, tonight he waits. He waits,” Smith said. The panel agreed that the Heat are still in trouble. Charles Barkley offered a harsh reality check on the team’s record. He noted the 76ers were missing their best player. “They gonna have to beat that team they played tonight,” Barkley said. “They had no Embiid, and Jaylen got hurt his hamstring, and that game was never close.” The loss exposes a real issue for Miami. They have two stars who need the ball. Giannis attacks the rim with force. Adebayo needs to attack just as hard. When Adebayo waits, the offense stalls. item.title: Cooper DeJean’s Cowboys cheerleader girlfriend Abby Summers in impossible position as Eagles star suffers concussion

item.title: Yoro red card: Written reasons for overturned decision revealed
item.description: The Football Association has released the written reasons why Leny Yoro's red card for Manchester United at Liverpool was overturned - even though refereeing body Pro Ref said the on-field decision was correct.

item.title: Delap's chance at redemption against toothless Chelsea
item.description: When Liam Delap joined Chelsea in the summer of 2025, he probably had ambitions of cementing himself as an elite Premier League No 9. Perhaps even positioning himself to be the heir to Harry Kane's throne for England.

item.title: Do Ferrari need to make Hamilton their No 1 driver?
item.description: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton's latest run-in at the Las Vegas Grand Prix has ramped up scrutiny on Ferrari and what the team will do to try to avoid more costly on-track incidents between their two drivers.

item.title: Mulder shreds Bangladesh as South Africa seal 2-0 sweep before England Tests
item.description: South Africa's Wiaan Mulder followed his fifth Test century with career-best bowling figures of 7-31 as the Proteas routed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs inside three days to secure a 2-0 sweep ahead of their three-match series versus England.

item.title: Khawaja 'hurt' by 'personal attacks' from Cummins in sandpaper denials
item.description: Usman Khawaja has told the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast that he was "hurt" by Pat Cummins' "personal attacks" on him as the Australia Test captain explosively disputed his claims that every member of the side was aware of the use of sandpaper in 2018.

item.title: Villeneuve: Verstappen showed 'race craft' edge over Mercedes pair in Vegas
item.description: Former Formula 1 world champion Jacques Villeneuve says Max Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix victory showed that Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will not be able to beat the Red Bull driver in next year's championship unless they have a superior car.

item.title: Stokes registers for 2027 IPL auction
item.description: Former England captain Ben ‌Stokes has registered for the 2027 Indian ‌Premier League auction, Cricinfo reported ​on Tuesday, with the all-rounder among the long list of names potentially set to go under the hammer in ‌Goa on December 16.

item.title: Sooryavanshi hits 28 sixes while smashing fastest double ton in List A cricket
item.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has broken more records as the teenage cricket sensation smashed his way to the fastest century and double century in List A cricket during India A's seven-wicket victory against the United Arab Emirates on Tuesday.

item.title: WHOLESOME moment Ackerman's son stands to applaud Test century
item.description: There was a wholesome moment as South Africa opener Marques Ackerman stepped off the pitch after a sensational knock of 150 in the second Test against Bangladesh with his young son applauding proudly in the crowd.

item.title: Stella 'liked' Piastri's fiery response to McLaren 'be careful' warnings
item.description: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella says he liked Oscar Piastri's fiery response to radio messages warning the Australian to "be careful" battling his team-mate Lando Norris during the Las Vegas Grand Prix.

item.title: Has Verstappen feud reignited at wrong time for Russell?
item.description: The reignition of the long-running feud between George Russell and Max Verstappen has added an entertaining twist to the end of the 2026 Formula 1 season, but it may not be what the Mercedes driver needed at this moment.

item.title: 'This cannot continue' - Ferrari to hold fresh Leclerc-Hamilton talks after collision
item.description: Ferrari team boss Frederic Vasseur says he will hold further discussions with drivers Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton after their latest tangle in the Las Vegas Grand Prix, admitting such incidents "cannot continue".
